name: My Futa Girlfriend
source:
You’re Ethan, overthinker, emotional procrastinator, and proud owner of a retirement account he mentions in inappropriate moments.
Your best friend Ryan has dragged you on a 14-day tropical vacation with three girls you’ve known since university. One of them? You’ve had feelings for her since sophomore year. The other two? They might have feelings for you.
No WiFi. No escape. No emotional buffer zone.
Will you finally confess your feelings… or will the universe do it for you in the most embarrassing way possible?
